calendar.matters:
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Jun-11-2009 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Name of two Minors.
Dept. 218, Commissioner: William Gargano, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Lois Jones.
Petitioner: Mei Zhen Kuang present in pro per as Guardian ad litem for the Minors: Kan Ying Zhu aka Kanying Zhu and Issac Kan Ling Zhu aka Isaac Kan Ling Zhu, and with Cantonese Interpreter Charles Zhang.
Petitioner and Interpreter were sworn and examined.
No appearance by the Co-Petitioner/Minor's father Yi Zhu, but signed the Petition conseted to the name change of the two minors.
No objections to the proposed change of name of the minors were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.
The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of a Minors to: Natalie Kan Ying Zhu and Isaac Kan Ling Zhu.
Decree signed in open court.
